Let \(\Delta\) be the area and \(s\) the semiperimeter. Using the correct exradius formula:

\[
r_a=\frac{\Delta}{s-a}=3,\quad r_b=\frac{\Delta}{s-b}=10,\quad r_c=\frac{\Delta}{s-c}=15
\]

Thus

\[
s-a=\frac{\Delta}{3},\quad s-b=\frac{\Delta}{10},\quad s-c=\frac{\Delta}{15}
\]

Adding these gives

\[
s=(s-a)+(s-b)+(s-c)=\Delta\left(\frac13+\frac1{10}+\frac1{15}\right)=\frac{\Delta}{2}
\]

So \(\Delta=2s\). By Heron's formula,

\[
\Delta^2=s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)
=s\left(\frac{\Delta}{3}\right)\left(\frac{\Delta}{10}\right)\left(\frac{\Delta}{15}\right)
=\frac{s\Delta^3}{450}
\]

Dividing by \(\Delta^2\),

\[
1=\frac{s\Delta}{450}
\]

Using \(\Delta=2s\),

\[
1=\frac{s(2s)}{450}=\frac{2s^2}{450}
\]

\[
s^2=225 \implies s=15
\]

Therefore the perimeter is

\[
2s=30
\]

\[
\boxed{30}
\]
